278408995.description:
Natural Stone Decor & Mineral Specimen Lot
Assorted Agate, Geode, and Stone Specimens
Natural Mineral, Various Sizes
This comprehensive collection features a variety of lapidary-themed decor and raw mineral specimens. The set is anchored by two unique desk clocks-one crafted from a large green stone slab and another from a polished agate slice. Accompanying these are numerous rough stones, including a crystal-filled geode half and a vibrant pink-dyed agate slice, offering a range of textures and colors suitable for rustic display or geological collection.
Green stone slab desk clock with brass-tone Roman numeral indices
Polished agate slice clock with translucent banding and quartz movement mechanism
Assorted rough mineral specimens including geodes and raw stone fragments
19-pound lot comprising over 20 pieces of varying shapes and sizes
Condition:
Natural stones exhibit characteristic inclusions and rough textures inherent to their formation. The clock mechanisms are attached to the reverse but have not been tested for functionality. Surface dust and light oxidation on metallic clock hands are visible. No major structural repairs or breaks noted to the primary stone bodies.
